premises.evidence_span: it's a sign that search is still too difficult to implement

premises.text: Combining the database, search index, and web server into one system removes the need to modify three separate places
premises.evidence_span: combining the database, the search index, and the web server into one system

premises.text: Companies across domains represent their data as objects with attributes
premises.evidence_span: every company represents their data as objects

premises.text: Native object handling (objects in, objects out, search across them) makes data modeling for search simple
premises.evidence_span: you put in objects, you get objects back, you search across them

premises.text: Attribute-level filtering exploits object information that incumbent site search cannot use
premises.evidence_span: we can take advantage of all the attribute information

premises.text: Search is fast and scalable right out of the box
premises.evidence_span: you get fast, scalable search right out of the box

premises.text: New attributes are added by uploading a new schema with no downtime, cutting development time
premises.evidence_span: Now we just upload a new schema, and that's it
